title: Market Research tournaments (mr.tournaments/1)
description: Every tournament the slice counts (Standard, with a ban list, at least the minimum players), newest first. The same for both sides.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version this file belongs to: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same as the v=<version>/ folder the file is in and the manifest's version.

restriction.description: Ban list these tournaments are filtered to, or all.

tier_group.description: Tier group these tournaments are filtered to, or all.

tournaments.description: Every tournament the slice's statistics count (Standard, with a ban list, at least thresholds.min_players players), newest first.

tid.description: Tournament ID: c<Cobra ID> for Cobra tournaments (linked to ABR or not), a<ABR ID> for ABR-only events.

name.description: Public tournament name. Null when the sources have none.

restriction.description: Ban list the tournament was played under (after any override in the quality report).

tier.description: Tier group ID of the tournament (see the manifest's tier_groups).

type.description: Tournament type as the source names it, lower case (e.g. store championship, intercontinental championship). Null when unknown.

online.description: Whether the tournament was played online.

country.description: Country as AlwaysBeRunning lists it. Null when the event isn't linked to ABR or has none.

swiss_format.description: single_sided (one game per round) or double_sided (a game on each side per round). Null when unknown.

cut_size.description: Players in the top cut; 0 when there was no cut.

cobra_id.description: NSG Cobra tournament ID. Null for ABR-only events.

abr_id.description: AlwaysBeRunning.net event ID. Null when not linked to ABR.

has_games.description: Whether game results (pairings) are known, i.e. whether the tournament counts towards winrates.

decklist_coverage.description: Entry-sides with a decklist / (2 x players), 0-1.

decklists.description: Legal decks with a known decklist (the decks the statistics use); out of 2 per player.
